Question: Define a sequence recursively by \(F_{0}=0,\) \(~F_{1}=1,\) and \(F_{n}=\) the remainder when \(F_{n-1}+F_{n-2}\) is divided by \(3,\) for all \(n\geq 2.\) Thus the sequence starts \(0,\) \(1,\) \(1,\) \(2,\) \(0,\) \(2,\) \(\ldots.\) What is \[ F_{2017}+F_{2018}+F_{2019}+F_{2020}+ F_{2021}+F_{2022}+F_{2023}+F_{2024}? \]
